absolute.name: Absoluto
absolute.meaning: The one Absolute of infinity (three Absolutes on subinfinite levels), conceived as the impersonal reaction of the Trinity; also the Buddhist concept of the Eternal One (56:9.5, Paper 94).

rejected.reason: The neuter article makes it an abstract quality; the papers treat it as a reality parallel to 'the Trinity' (56:9.5).

absolute-buddha.name: Buda Absoluto
absolute-buddha.meaning: The Buddhist concept of the Buddha as the Eternal One of infinite existence, the Buddhist approach to Deity (Paper 94).

rejected.reason: 'Buda' is the standard Spanish form of the historical name (rule 2).

absolute-deity.name: Deidad Absoluta
absolute-deity.meaning: Deity on the absolute level; the absolute aspect of Deity, distinct from the Deity Absolute (0:1.13, 56:9).

rejected.reason: That is the form of 'Deity Absolute'; the order of the English words marks two terms.

absolute-mind-person.name: Mente Absoluta (persona)
absolute-mind-person.meaning: The Infinite Spirit as the personalization of absolute mind (3:1.8, 9:7.4).

rejected.reason: 'Intelecto' would break the 'mind = mente' family.

absolute-person.name: Persona Absoluta
absolute-person.meaning: The Eternal Son, the absolute personality, though not in the experiential sense the personalization of the Absolute (0:5.5, 56:9.5).

rejected.reason: 'Personality' and 'person' are different English words; 0:5.5 uses 'absolute personality' separately.

absolutes.name: Absolutos
absolutes.meaning: The seven Absolutes of Infinity, the eternal and co-ordinate premises of all reality (Father, Son, Spirit, Paradise, and the three potential Absolutes); 'three absolute actuals' names the Father, Son, and Spirit or the actual side against the three potential Absolutes (Paper 105, 0:11).

rejected.reason: False friend: Spanish 'actual' means 'current, present-day'.
'Actualizado' commonly means 'updated'.
'Real' also means 'royal', and as a noun a coin.

adam.name: Adán
adam.meaning: The Material Son sent with Eve to Urantia as a biologic uplifter (51:0.1).

adjuster-expression.name: expresión del Ajustador
adjuster-expression.meaning: The expression of the indwelling Adjuster through the mortal mind and personality (Paper 110).

rejected.reason: Not natural Spanish; the hyphen compound does not exist.

adjuster-fused-mortals.name: mortales fusionados con el Ajustador
adjuster-fused-mortals.meaning: Ascending mortals whose souls have fused with their indwelling Thought Adjuster; one of three orders of fusion (40:9.1, 40:10.2).

rejected.reason: 'Fundido' also means 'melted' or 'burnt out'.

adjuster-fusion.name: fusión con el Ajustador
adjuster-fusion.meaning: The eternal union of the surviving mortal soul with the indwelling Thought Adjuster (40:9.1, Paper 110).

rejected.reason: Reads as the Adjuster fusing with something else by itself.

adjutant-mind-spirits.name: espíritus ayudantes de la mente
adjutant-mind-spirits.meaning: Seven spirits, children of the Universe Mother Spirit, that minister mind to the lower orders of intelligent life and condition organic evolution (36:5.1, 101:5.10).

rejected.reason: A calque; the hyphen compound is not natural in Spanish.
'Adjunto' means attached or an assistant rank; less clear than 'ayudante'.

rejected.form: espíritu de valor (for spirit of courage)
rejected.reason: 'Valor' also means 'value', a frequent term in the papers; 'coraje' has one sense.

rejected.form: espíritu de culto (for spirit of worship)
rejected.reason: 'Culto' is ritual or a sect; 'adoración' is the act of worship.

ancients-of-days.name: Ancianos de Días
ancients-of-days.meaning: The Trinity-origin rulers of the superuniverses, three on each capital, whom ascenders meet in the superuniverse (18:3.1).

rejected.reason: 'Antiguo' describes old things or former holders of a role, not an elder person.
The extra article is not in the English and makes it less like a title.

andites.name: Anditas
andites.meaning: The best all-round human stock since the violet race, a blend of Adamite and Nodite remnants with the best of other races (78:4.3, 80:4.5).

andonites.name: Andonitas
andonites.meaning: The first human race, descendants of Andon and Fonta, swarthy hunters who resembled the present-day Eskimo (63:4.1, 63:5.6).

rejected.reason: Spanish writes peoples in lowercase, but this name exists only in this book and the packet keeps English capitals on coined terms.

andrew.name: Andrés
andrew.meaning: Andrew, brother of Peter, the first apostle and chairman of the twelve (139:1.1).

apostles-of-jesus.name: apóstoles de Jesús
apostles-of-jesus.meaning: The twelve men Jesus chose as his personal companions and ambassadors of the kingdom (138:0.1, 139:0.1).

rejected.reason: 'Ignorante' adds an insult; 'iletrado' keeps the sense of no formal schooling.

ascending-mortals.name: mortales ascendentes
aliases: mortales fusionados con el Ajustador en ascenso
ascending-mortals.meaning: Mortals who survive and progress from the material worlds through the mansion worlds, the superuniverse, and Havona to Paradise (49:0.1, 47:3.12, 53:3.6).

rejected.reason: False friend: 'ascendiente' means an ancestor or an influence.
Plain, but does not work as a noun phrase in all contexts; the English 'ascendant' and 'ascending' both go to 'ascendente'.

caligastia-one-hundred.name: cien de Caligastia
caligastia-one-hundred.meaning: The corporeal members of the Planetary Prince's staff, fifty men and fifty women, who came to Urantia in material bodies (66:2.3, 66:4.2).

rejected.reason: Is a military staff; the papers mean a corps of assistants and teachers.
The English writes 'one hundred' in lowercase.

chief-of-mystery-monitors.name: jefe de los Monitores de Misterio
chief-of-mystery-monitors.meaning: The being who presides over the college of Personalized Adjusters on Divinington and advises Master Spirit Number One (Paper 107).

rejected.reason: 'Misteriosos' describes them as secretive; the English uses 'Mystery' as a name element.

christian-church-early.name: iglesia cristiana primitiva
aliases: naciente culto del cristianismo de Pablo
christian-church-early.meaning: The church that grew after Pentecost under Peter and Paul and that became a religion about Jesus, mixed with Greek and pagan elements (194:4.0, 195:0.1, 196:2.1).

rejected.reason: Spanish writes adjectives of religion in lowercase; the English capital on 'Christian' is a rule of English, not a coined term.
'Temprana' is a calque of 'early'; 'primitiva' is the plain Spanish word for the first period.

christianity.name: cristianismo
christianity.meaning: The religion about Jesus that grew after him, with more of his gospel than any other faith but with additions he did not teach (195:0.1, 196:2.1).

contact-personalities.name: personalidades de contacto
contact-personalities.meaning: The few (fewer than a score) reservists who are conscious of their role as points of contact between superhuman beings and mortals, and the midwayers who serve these contacts (114:7.8, 77:8.8).

rejected.reason: Reads as an office 'contact person'; and 'person' is a different English word.

corps-of-mortal-finaliters.name: Cuerpo de Finalitarios Mortales
corps-of-mortal-finaliters.meaning: The corps that is the present known destination of the ascending Adjuster-fused mortals, with other groups also assigned to it (31:0.1, 107:2.7).

rejected.reason: Kept as the alias for 'Corps of the Finality' because it pairs with 'finalitario', but Spanish 'finalidad' usually means 'purpose', not 'final state'. A human reviewer must decide; an alternative is 'Cuerpo de los Finalitarios'.

creative-mother-spirits.name: Espíritus Madre Creativos
creative-mother-spirits.meaning: The local universe Mother Spirits seen in their creative partnership with the Creator Sons (Paper 34, 39:1.2 'Creative Spirit').

rejected.reason: 'Creadores' is fixed for 'Creator' (Hijos Creadores); 'Creative' is a different English word.
The reader must not bring the artistic or marketing sense; it means 'creating'.

creative-spirits.name: Espíritus Creativos
creative-spirits.meaning: The local universe Mother Spirits, Creative Daughters of the Infinite Spirit, who create and administer with the Creator Sons (8:5.3, 39:1.2).

rejected.reason: Merges 'Creative' with 'Creator'; the papers keep the two words apart.

creator-sons.name: Hijos Creadores
creator-sons.meaning: The makers and rulers of the local universes, Paradise Sons of the order of Michael, born of the Father and the Eternal Son (21:0.1, 32:0.1).

rejected.reason: 'Michael' is here the name of an order of Sons; the Spanish name 'Miguel' brings in the archangel and a common personal name. See michael-of-nebadon.

deity.name: Deidad
deity.meaning: Divine reality as it functions on diverse levels, personal or not, divinely co-ordinated (0:1.1, 16:0.1).

rejected.reason: The papers use 'divinity' as a separate term for the quality of Deity (Foreword section 'Deity and Divinity').

deity-absolute.name: Absoluto de la Deidad
deity-absolute.meaning: The potential that the Father's free will segregated from total infinite reality, within which all divinity activities take place; the Qualified Absolute (0:10.1, 0:11.6).

rejected.reason: Not natural Spanish; reads as a typing error.
That is the form of 'Absolute Deity', a different term; the two must stay distinct.

discerners-of-spirits.name: Discernidores de Espíritus
discerners-of-spirits.meaning: Secondary seconaphim attached to the Universal Censors who, by inherent spiritual insight, present unerring portraits of the soul and motives of a being (28:5.20).

rejected.reason: 'Discerniente' is an adjective (discerning), not an agent noun.
Changes the idea: they discern and present; the Censors judge.

eternal-son.name: Hijo Eterno
eternal-son.meaning: The Second Source and Center, the perfect expression of the Father's first absolute thought, the Word-God (6:0.1, 8:0.1).

eternity.name: eternidad
eternity.meaning: Timeless existence, the everlasting now, in which potential infinity is inseparable (0:11.12, 13:1.9).

rejected.reason: Means endless duration in time, which is the opposite of timelessness.

europe.name: Europa
europe.meaning: The continent of Europe, settled by the blue man and later by the Andites (80:4.5, 80:5.8).

father-absolute.name: Padre-Absoluto
father-absolute.meaning: The Universal Father as the creator of the central universe and Father of all Creators, absolute in liberty of action (4:4.4, 10:3.8, 4:4.9).

rejected.reason: Without the hyphen it reads as a description ('the absolute father'); the English hyphen marks a name, like 'Father-Infinite'.

finaliters.name: finalitarios
finaliters.meaning: Ascenders who complete the Paradise ascension and enter the Corps of the Finality, the present known destination of Adjuster-fused mortals (31:0.1, 107:2.7).

rejected.reason: Means a finalist in a contest.
Means those who finish or end a thing.

foundation-of-spiritual-progress.name: Fundación del Progreso Espiritual
foundation-of-spiritual-progress.meaning: An institution on a neighboring planet that supervises spiritual teachers who visit families, supported by voluntary gifts (Paper 72).

rejected.reason: Adds a purpose that the English 'of' does not state.

gabriel.name: Gabriel
gabriel.meaning: The Bright and Morning Star, first creation of the Creator Son and the Mother Spirit and chief executive of Nebadon (33:4.1).

rejected.reason: 'Lucero' is the planet Venus and is a traditional name for Lucifer; that sense is the opposite of what the authors mean.

god.name: Dios
god.meaning: God, the Universal Father, First Source and Center and the eternal God who dwells on Paradise (0:0.5, 1:0.1).

god-the-absolute.name: Dios el Absoluto
god-the-absolute.meaning: The experiential Deity whose actualization would follow the unification of the Absolute Trinity: the realization of absolute divinity (0:10.1).

rejected.reason: Reads as a description ('the absolute God') and breaks the pattern 'Dios el Espíritu', 'Dios el Supremo'.

god-the-spirit.name: Dios el Espíritu
god-the-spirit.meaning: The Infinite Spirit, Third Person of the Paradise Trinity (8:0.4, 13:1.10).

rejected.reason: Drops the article and reads as a description ('God, who is spirit') instead of the name.

gospel.name: evangelio
gospel.meaning: The good news Jesus proclaimed: the fatherhood of God and the brotherhood of man, the kingdom received by faith (194:3.8, 170:0.1).

rejected.reason: A correct gloss, but not a single term; 'evangelio' is the plain word.
Capital reads as a book of the New Testament; the English uses lowercase for the message.

great-spirit.name: Gran Espíritu
great-spirit.meaning: The deity concept of the American red men, revived by Onamonalonton and kept from the Dalamatian teachings (64:6.7, 92:4.5).

rejected.reason: After the noun 'grande' means physical size; 'Gran' before the noun gives the sense of greatness.

greece.name: Grecia
greece.meaning: Ancient Greece and its culture and philosophy (98:1.1, 195:1.1).

havona.name: Havona
havona.meaning: The eternal central universe of perfect worlds that surrounds Paradise (0:0.5, 14:0.1).

high-spirit-personalities-of-circuit-con.name: altas personalidades espirituales del control de circuitos (no reveladas)
high-spirit-personalities-of-circuit-con.meaning: Unrevealed high spirit personalities who help the circuit supervisors direct the circuits for spirit messages and the transit of personalities (Paper 24).

rejected.form: altas personalidades de espíritu del control de circuitos
rejected.reason: Awkward; 'de espíritu' reads as 'spirited'.
'Superiores' is reserved for 'higher' (Personalidades Superiores del Espíritu Infinito).

higher-personalities-of-the-infinite-spi.name: Personalidades Superiores del Espíritu Infinito
higher-personalities-of-the-infinite-spi.meaning: The seven orders of higher personalities of the Infinite Spirit (Solitary Messengers, Universe Circuit Supervisors, Census Directors, Personal Aids, Associate Inspectors, Assigned Sentinels, Graduate Guides) (Paper 24, 45:1.8).

rejected.reason: 'Alta' is used for 'high' elsewhere in the papers; 'Higher' is a comparative and needs 'Superiores'.

holy-spirit.name: Espíritu Santo
holy-spirit.meaning: The spiritual circuit of the local universe Creative Spirit (Divine Minister), confined to the local universe, distinct from the omnipresent Infinite Spirit (8:5.3, 34:5.5, 194:2.17).

rejected.reason: Not natural Spanish for this name; 'Espíritu Santo' is the plain form and matches the scriptural phrase the papers quote.

rejected.form: (ordinary sense) third person of the Christian Trinity
rejected.reason: The reader must not identify it with the Infinite Spirit; the papers define it as the circuit of the local universe Mother Spirit (8:5.3).

impersonal.name: impersonal
impersonal.meaning: Without personality; the impersonal never transmutes directly into the personal (0:5.4, 0:1.17, 56:9.5).

rejected.reason: 'Nonpersonal' is a separate English word in the papers (0:5.2, 0:5.5).
The reader must not read it as a lack of warmth.

india.name: India
india.meaning: The land of India, home of a very mixed population of all the races (79:2.1).

rejected.reason: Refers to the religion; 'indio' is the gentilic. Note that 'indio' can also mean a native American in Latin America; context decides.

infinite-spirit.name: Espíritu Infinito
infinite-spirit.meaning: The Third Person of Deity, the agent of the combined action of the Father and the Son, the God of Action and source of mind (8:0.1, 8:1.1, 23:0.1).

rejected.reason: 'Agente' can read as a representative or a police agent; 'Actor' keeps the sense of the one who acts, as in the English.
'Manipulador' carries a sense of deceit in Spanish, as 'manipulator' does in English; kept because the English uses this word for the handling of energies. Reviewer can check.

infinity.name: infinitud
infinity.meaning: The quality and level of the infinite: the unqualified reality of the I AM, potential infinity being absolute and inseparable from eternity (0:3.21, 0:11.1, 0:11.12).

rejected.reason: Common Spanish for 'a huge number' (una infinidad de cosas); it loses the quality sense.
Reserved for 'the Infinite' (0:3.24), a different English term.

james-zebedee.name: Santiago Zebedeo
james-zebedee.meaning: James, son of Zebedee and brother of John, one of the twelve and the first apostle martyred (139:3.1).

rejected.reason: Used in some Bibles, but 'Santiago' is the common Spanish name of this apostle across countries.

jerusalem-temple.name: templo de Jerusalén
jerusalem-temple.meaning: The temple at Jerusalem, center of Jewish worship and sacrifice, where Jesus taught (173:1.1).

jerusem.name: Jerusem
jerusem.meaning: The headquarters world of the local system of Satania, encircled by fifty-six worlds of transition culture (47:0.1, 46:5.27).

jesus.name: Jesús
jesus.meaning: Jesus of Nazareth, the human life on Urantia of the Creator Son Michael of Nebadon (0:0.5, 194:3.1).

jews.name: judíos
jews.meaning: The Jewish people, descendants of the Hebrews (97:0.1, 121:2.1).

john-the-baptist.name: Juan el Bautista
john-the-baptist.meaning: John, son of Zacharias and Elizabeth, who preached repentance and baptized Jesus (135:0.1).

john-zebedee.name: Juan Zebedeo
john-zebedee.meaning: John, son of Zebedee, the youngest of the twelve apostles (139:4.1).

judaism.name: judaísmo
judaism.meaning: The religion of the Jews that grew from the Hebrew faith and held the concept of one God (97:0.1, 121:2.1).

judas-iscariot.name: Judas Iscariote
judas-iscariot.meaning: The Judean apostle, treasurer of the twelve, who betrayed Jesus (139:12.1).

kc-absolute.name: absoluto
kc-absolute.meaning: Beginningless, endless, timeless, spaceless, and unconditioned; the third level of reality after the finite and the absonite (0:1.13, 0:11.12).

rejected.reason: 'Total' and 'totality' are separate words in the papers.
The reader must not read it as a mere intensifier ('un absoluto desastre').

kc-associate.name: asociado
kc-associate.meaning: As noun, one who works together with another; as verb and adjective, joined in relation or function (0:1.6 'Associative Deity', 0:5.4, 8:0.4 'eternally associated persons').

rejected.reason: A business partner or a club member; a commercial sense.
Too informal and personal; loses the sense of joined function.
The reader must not bring the firm or law-office rank to it.

kc-co-ordinate.name: coordinar
kc-co-ordinate.meaning: As verb, to bring into unified and harmonious function; as adjective, equal in rank or status, as the three Paradise Deities are co-ordinate (7:7.1, 8:0.4, 42:12.13 'On Paradise the three energies are co-ordinate, in Havona co-ordinated').

rejected.reason: Mathematical 'co-ordinate' (axes); a false sense.
Explains the adjective and breaks the family with the verb, which 42:12.13 sets side by side.
As an adjective the reader must also take 'of equal rank', as in grammar ('oraciones coordinadas'), not only 'organized'.

kc-evolutionary.name: evolutivo
kc-evolutionary.meaning: Of time-space creatures and realms that grow and progress through experience from lower to higher states, as against existential or Paradise origin (0:1.18, 0:5.1, 16:4.1).

rejected.reason: Anglicism, not standard Spanish.
Means 'a supporter of the theory of evolution', an ideological sense.

kc-finite.name: finito
kc-finite.meaning: The level of reality of creature life and time-space limitations; finite realities always have beginnings (0:1.11).

rejected.reason: Plain 'limited'; loses the technical level set against 'absonite' and 'absolute'.

kc-indwelling.name: morada interior
kc-indwelling.meaning: The dwelling of a divine spirit (above all the Thought Adjuster) within the mind of a mortal; as adjective, 'the indwelling spirit' is the spirit that lives within (0:5.9, 0:5.10, 34:6.7).

rejected.reason: A technical term of Christian theology for the Holy Spirit in the soul; a religious sense the authors did not set.
Reads as a home address or a legal residence permit.

kc-infinite.name: infinito
kc-infinite.meaning: Without limit; the fullness implied by the primacy of the First Source and Center; 'the Infinite' (capital) is the Father-Infinite (0:3.24, 0:1).

rejected.reason: Plain 'unlimited'; loses the technical level of 'infinite' set against 'finite' and 'absolute'.

kc-mortal.name: mortal
kc-mortal.meaning: A will creature of material, evolutionary origin who is subject to physical death, and who can survive it by the soul (0:5.10, 40:9.1).

rejected.reason: Too narrow: the papers apply 'mortal' to will creatures on many worlds, not only to Urantia humans.
As an adjective Spanish 'mortal' also means 'deadly' (herida mortal, pecado mortal); the reader must not bring this sense to 'mente mortal' or 'vida mortal'.

kc-prepersonal.name: prepersonal
kc-prepersonal.meaning: Of a reality that is not yet a personality but is destined to become part of one, as the Thought Adjuster (0:5.9, 0:1.3, 0:5.4).

rejected.reason: Explains and loses the term.

kc-spirit-born.name: nacido del espíritu
kc-spirit-born.meaning: Said of a mortal or a soul that has been born of the spirit, that is, has received and recognized the indwelling of God and lives under spirit leading (34:6.7, 34:6.13, 193:2.2, 42:12.12).

rejected.reason: Brings the evangelical 'born-again' label, a cultural sense the authors do not use.
The capital would decide that the spirit is the Spirit (a person); the English lowercase compound leaves this open, so the lowercase stays.

kc-spirit-luminosity.name: luminosidad espiritual
kc-spirit-luminosity.meaning: The 'light' that is the personality manifestation of spirit beings; a figure of speech, not related to intellectual insight or to physical light (0:6.8, 0:6.9).

rejected.reason: 'Luz' is the papers' 'light', the general word of which 'spirit luminosity' is one of three kinds (0:6.8).
Can read as the brightness of a person's mood or wit; 'espiritual' marks the spirit level better.

rejected.form: (ordinary sense) the 'spiritual glow' of a saintly person
rejected.reason: The reader must not take it as a religious aura or a holy look; the papers make it a manifestation of spirit beings.

kc-spiritual.name: espiritual
kc-spiritual.meaning: Of or pertaining to spirit: that which responds to the spirit circuit of the Eternal Son and to the spirit level of reality, as against the material and the mindal (0:6.1, 0:6.2, 42:12.13).

rejected.reason: Means 'spiritist' (contact with the dead) or a philosophical school; a sense the authors do not intend.
The reader must not read it as a mood or a personal temperament; in the papers it names a level of reality.

kc-superpersonal.name: superpersonal
kc-superpersonal.meaning: Of a reality above the level of personality as creatures know it, as Deity functions superpersonally (0:1.2, 0:1.3, 0:5.4).

rejected.reason: Breaks the 'super-' family of the papers (superuniverso, superpersonal).

kc-totality.name: totalidad
kc-totality.meaning: The whole of something taken all together, as the totality of cosmic reality or of the co-ordinated infinite nature of God (1:5.13, 10:4.6, 42:2.3).

rejected.reason: Means a set or a group; loses the sense of the complete whole.

life-carriers.name: Portadores de Vida
life-carriers.meaning: Local universe Sons who design life, carry it to the planets, plant it, and foster its development (36:0.1).

rejected.reason: 'Transportador' reads as freight or a machine.
Correct, but the article makes it read less as a term; the English has no article.

local-universe-mother-spirits.name: Espíritus Madre de los universos locales
aliases: Espíritus Creativos de los Universos Locales
Espíritu Madre de un universo local
local-universe-mother-spirits.meaning: The individualized representation of the Infinite Spirit who joins each Creator Son to organize, create, and minister in a local universe; the adjutants are her children (34:0.1, 36:5.1).

rejected.reason: In Spanish a noun in apposition stays singular ('Espíritus Madre'), as in other compound names.
'Creador' is the translation of 'Creator' (Creator Sons); 'Creative' is a different English word, so it gets 'Creativo'.
The papers refer to the Mother Spirit as 'her'; the feminine 'Ministra' agrees.

local-universes.name: universos locales
local-universes.meaning: The creations of the Creator Sons, each of one hundred constellations of one hundred systems of inhabited worlds (32:0.1).

lucifer-rebellion.name: rebelión de Lucifer
lucifer-rebellion.meaning: The revolt of Lucifer, System Sovereign of Satania, against the universe plan and the rule of Michael (53:0.1, 53:3.6).

mansion-world-students.name: estudiantes de los mundos morada
mansion-world-students.meaning: All surviving mortals who reawaken on the mansion worlds, as one class of ascending mortals (30:4.14, 47:3.9).

mansion-worlds.name: mundos morada
mansion-worlds.meaning: The seven satellites of the first transition world of Jerusem, where surviving mortals first reawaken; the name refers to Jesus' saying about 'many mansions in the Father's universe' (47:0.1, 30:4.14).

rejected.reason: Spanish 'mansión' means a luxurious house; the papers mean dwelling places, as in the saying of Jesus.
Same luxury sense, and longer.
Reads as a ranch or a short stay; loses the link to the saying.

mary-mother-of-jesus.name: María (madre de Jesús)
mary-mother-of-jesus.meaning: Mary, the earthly mother of Jesus and wife of Joseph (122:1.2).

master-physical-controllers.name: Controladores Físicos Maestros
master-physical-controllers.meaning: The mobile subordinates of the Supreme Power Centers who control physical energies and travel fast through local space (29:4.1, 41:3.1).

rejected.reason: 'Maestro' before the noun reads as a teacher of controllers; after the noun it means principal, as in 'Espíritus Maestros'.

master-spirits-seven.name: Espíritus Maestros, Siete
master-spirits-seven.meaning: The seven primary personalities of the Infinite Spirit, one for each superuniverse, who represent all seven possible associations of the three Deities (16:0.1, 15:0.1).

rejected.reason: Adds the idea of governing; 'Master' here means primary or chief, which 'maestro' as an adjective carries (as in 'plan maestro').
Plain adjective; does not read as a term and breaks one word, one translation with Master Physical Controllers.

material-sons.name: Hijos Materiales
material-sons.meaning: The order of Sons sent in pairs, as Adam and Eve, to uplift the races of an evolutionary world biologically (51:0.1).

melchizedek-sons.name: Hijos Melquisedec
melchizedek-sons.meaning: An order of local universe Sons who serve as teachers, advisers, and emergency ministers; Machiventa Melchizedek of Salem was one of them (35:0.1, 49:0.1, 45:6.8).

rejected.reason: The name also belongs to the Melchizedek of Genesis, so the standard Spanish spelling 'Melquisedec' applies (rule for historical names). Reviewer can check this choice.
'de' makes them the children of one person; the name is the name of the order.

messiah.name: Mesías
messiah.meaning: The anointed deliverer that the Jews expected, a hope that Jesus did not fulfill in the temporal sense (136:1.1).

michael-of-nebadon.name: Miguel de Nebadon
michael-of-nebadon.meaning: The Creator Son of the order of Michael who made and rules the local universe of Nebadon and who lived on Urantia as Jesus (35:0.1, 194:2.4).

rejected.reason: 'Miguel' brings in the archangel of tradition and a common personal name; the papers use Michael as the name of an order of Creator Sons, so the name is kept like the other names of this book.
replaced by a human decision

decision.note: "Miguel" is the standard Spanish form of the name, as with Jesús, Juan, and Melquisedec
"Miguel" is the standard Spanish form of the name, as with Jesús, Juan, and Melquisedec

midwayers.name: seres intermedios
midwayers.meaning: Beings who live on a level about midway between mortals and the angelic orders, hence called midway creatures (77:0.1).

rejected.reason: As a noun, 'intermedio' is an intermission.
Means a go-between or middleman; the papers mean a level of life, not a role.
Means a mediator or party wall; changes the idea.

mortals.name: mortales
mortals.meaning: Will creatures of animal origin on the evolutionary worlds, the lowest order of personal creation, able to survive and ascend to Paradise (49:0.1, 107:0.2).

mother-spirits.name: Espíritus Madre
mother-spirits.meaning: The local universe Mother Spirits, consorts of the Creator Sons (Paper 34).

rejected.reason: Breaks the fixed form 'Espíritus Madre de los universos locales'.

mystery-monitors.name: Monitores de Misterio
mystery-monitors.meaning: Another name of the Thought Adjusters, the divine fragments of the Father that indwell mortal minds (Paper 107).

rejected.reason: Makes 'mystery' an adjective of character (secretive).
'Vigilante' is a security guard; it loses the advising sense of 'monitor'.
The reader must not bring the screen or the camp-instructor sense; it means one who watches and admonishes.

nathaniel-apostle.name: Natanael (apóstol)
nathaniel-apostle.meaning: Nathaniel of Cana, the sixth apostle, brought to Jesus by Philip (139:6.1).

nebadon.name: Nebadon
nebadon.meaning: The local universe in which Urantia is, the creation of Michael (0:0.5, 35:0.1).

old-testament.name: Antiguo Testamento
old-testament.meaning: The Hebrew scriptures, which Jesus treated as human writings that contain truth and error (159:4.1).

paradise.name: Paraíso
paradise.meaning: The stationary Isle at the geographic center of infinity and the dwelling place of the eternal God (0:0.5, 11:0.1).

rejected.reason: Lowercase reads as the general idea of heaven or the garden; the papers mean a specific place.

paradise-sons-of-god.name: Hijos de Dios del Paraíso
paradise-sons-of-god.meaning: The Sons of God of Paradise origin: Creator Sons, Magisterial Sons, and Trinity Teacher Sons (20:0.1, 35:0.1).

rejected.reason: Reads as 'Sons of God's Paradise'.
'Paradisíaco' reads as 'idyllic'.

paradise-trinity.name: Trinidad del Paraíso
paradise-trinity.meaning: The eternal union of the Universal Father, the Eternal Son, and the Infinite Spirit (10:0.1, 15:0.1).

rejected.reason: The adjective reads as 'idyllic' in common use.

paul.name: Pablo
paul.meaning: Paul of Tarsus, missionary to the gentiles and founder of much of early Christian theology (194:4.0, 196:2.1).

pentecost-bestowal-of-spirit-of-truth.name: Pentecostés (otorgamiento del Espíritu de la Verdad)
pentecost-bestowal-of-spirit-of-truth.meaning: The day on which the Spirit of Truth was poured out upon all flesh after Jesus' ascension, which transformed the apostles and the believers (Paper 194, 194:2.17, 34:5.5).

rejected.form: Pentecostés (donación del Espíritu de la Verdad)
rejected.reason: 'Donación' reads as a charitable or legal donation; 'otorgamiento' keeps the sense of a gift that is conferred.

rejected.form: Pentecostés (efusión del Espíritu de la Verdad)
rejected.reason: Translates 'outpouring', not 'bestowal'; it is a different English word in the papers.

personal-aids-of-the-infinite-spirit.name: Auxiliares Personales del Espíritu Infinito
personal-aids-of-the-infinite-spirit.meaning: Beings, numbered in trillions, who serve only the Paradise presence of the Infinite Spirit and flash through the universes to execute his bidding, without a discoverable personality form (Paper 24, 24:4).

rejected.reason: 'Ayudantes' is already the fixed form for 'adjutant' (espíritus ayudantes de la mente); using it here would merge two different English words.
Reads as an office job title (personal assistant).

personality.name: personalidad
personality.meaning: The unique gift of the Universal Father, the one changeless reality in creature experience, which unifies body, mind, spirit, and soul without being any of them (0:5.11, 0:5.4, 1:5.13).

rejected.reason: 'Person' is a different English word in the papers.

rejected.form: (ordinary sense) personalidad = 'character traits, temperament' or 'a celebrity'
rejected.reason: The reader must not read it as psychological character or as 'a famous person'; it is a bestowed reality.

personalized-adjusters.name: Ajustadores Personalizados
personalized-adjusters.meaning: Thought Adjusters who have received personality from the Father, usually after indwelling an incarnated Paradise Son or after unusual service (Paper 109, Paper 136).

rejected.reason: Loses the sense of an act of personalization.
The reader must not read it as 'custom-made'; it means 'given personality'.

primitive-mortals.name: mortales primitivos
primitive-mortals.meaning: Mortals in the early stages of evolution on a world, before advanced civilization (e.g. 39:5.7 'primitive men').

rejected.reason: 'Primigenio' means 'original, first of all', which changes the idea from 'early stage' to 'origin'.

qualified-absolute.name: Absoluto Condicionado
qualified-absolute.meaning: The Deity Absolute, the absolute potential segregated by the Father's choice, in contrast to the Unqualified Absolute (0:11.6, 0:10.1).

rejected.reason: 'Cualificado' means 'skilled, trained'.
'Calificado' means 'graded' or 'skilled'.

races.name: razas
races.meaning: The human races of Urantia: the Andonites, the six Sangik races, and later blends with Nodites and Adamites (63:4.1, 64:6.1, 78:4.3).

red-race.name: raza roja
red-race.meaning: The first of the six Sangik races, which went to the Americas (64:6.2).

reflective-mother-spirits.name: Espíritus Madre Reflectivos
reflective-mother-spirits.meaning: The Reflective Spirits in their role as mothers of the Reflective Image Aids and the seconaphim (Paper 17, Paper 28).

rejected.reason: 'Reflexivo' means 'thoughtful'; see Reflective Spirits.

reflective-spirits.name: Espíritus Reflectivos
reflective-spirits.meaning: Forty-nine Spirits of Trinity origin on the superuniverse capitals, seven of each Master Spirit type, who operate universe reflectivity and are the mothers of the seconaphim (28:0, 40:10.2, 13:1.10).

rejected.reason: 'Reflexivo' means 'thoughtful' or grammatical 'reflexive'; the term names the reflection (reflectivity) of images and information, not thought.
'Reflector' reads as a device (a spotlight, a mirror) rather than a quality.

religion.name: religión
religion.meaning: Religion is the personal experience of divinity in the consciousness of a moral being, a faith and assurance, not a system of belief (101:1.1, 101:0.3, 101:2.13).

rejected.reason: Means ritual worship or a sect; the papers contrast religion with mere ritual and dogma.

roman-empire.name: Imperio romano
roman-empire.meaning: The Roman Empire of Jesus' time and after (195:3.1).

sanhedrin.name: Sanedrín
sanhedrin.meaning: The supreme Jewish council and court at Jerusalem that opposed Jesus and brought about his trial (184:0.1, 172:2.1).

self-acting-adjusters.name: Ajustadores autoactuantes
self-acting-adjusters.meaning: A functional class of experienced Adjusters able to act on their own initiative, to leave the body, and to communicate with others of their kind (109:2.1, 109:2.9, 108:4.4).

rejected.reason: 'Autónomo' commonly means 'self-employed' or 'regional government'.

rejected.form: Ajustadores que actúan por sí mismos
rejected.reason: Explains and loses the form of a class name.

seraphim.name: serafines
seraphim.meaning: The angels of the local universes, offspring of the Infinite Spirit as personalized on the local universe headquarters, who minister to mortals (39:0.1).

rejected.reason: The Spanish plural 'serafines' is the plain, standard word, and the English also uses the plain word.

seven-absolutes-of-infinity.name: Siete Absolutos de la Infinitud
seven-absolutes-of-infinity.meaning: The seven eternal premises of reality: Universal Father, Eternal Son, Infinite Spirit, Isle of Paradise, Deity Absolute, Universal Absolute, Unqualified Absolute (Paper 105).

rejected.reason: 'Infinidad' means 'a huge number'; 'infinity' is 'infinitud' in every term.

seven-spirits-of-god.name: siete espíritus de Dios
seven-spirits-of-god.meaning: The seven spirits that the prophet saw in vision 'like lamps burning before the throne'; elsewhere the papers apply 'the Seven Spirits of God' to the Seven Master Spirits (16:4.1).

rejected.reason: Keep the English case of each passage: capitals where the papers capitalize (16:4.1), lowercase in the vision passage.

seven-spirits-of-havona-circuits.name: Siete Espíritus de los Circuitos de Havona
seven-spirits-of-havona-circuits.meaning: The joint impersonal representation of the Infinite Spirit and the Seven Master Spirits to the seven circuits of Havona, one Spirit pervading each circuit (Paper 24, 24:1).

rejected.form: Siete Espíritus de los Circuitos havonianos
rejected.reason: Turns the coined place name into an adjective; the name Havona must stay in its English form.

seven-worlds-of-infinite-spirit.name: siete mundos del Espíritu Infinito
seven-worlds-of-infinite-spirit.meaning: The seven sacred spheres of the Infinite Spirit that circle Paradise (Paper 13).

rejected.reason: 'Esfera' translates 'sphere', a different English word.

simon-peter.name: Simón Pedro
simon-peter.meaning: Simon Peter, fisherman and spokesman of the twelve apostles (139:2.1).

solitary-messengers.name: Mensajeros Solitarios
solitary-messengers.meaning: The personal and universal messenger corps of the Infinite Spirit, the first order of the Higher Personalities of the Infinite Spirit, who function alone (23:0.1).

son-spirit-ministers.name: ministros Hijo-Espíritu
son-spirit-ministers.meaning: The first group of supreme seraphim, who serve the high Sons and the Spirit-origin beings of the local universe, the Universe Son and the Universe Spirit (39:1.2).

rejected.form: ministros del Hijo y del Espíritu
rejected.reason: Explains the compound and loses its form as a name.
Breaks the 'minister/ministry' family (ministerio) that the papers use for angelic service.

rejected.form: (ordinary sense) ministro = government minister or clergyman
rejected.reason: The reader must not bring the cabinet or the church office to it; it means one who ministers.

sons-of-god.name: Hijos de Dios
sons-of-god.meaning: All the orders of divine sonship, classified as descending, ascending, and trinitized Sons (20:0.1, 35:0.1).

space-levels.name: niveles del espacio
space-levels.meaning: The concentric elliptical paths of the master universe around Paradise, separated by relatively quiet zones (12:1.1, 11:7.7).

rejected.reason: Correct, but 'espacial' often reads as spaceflight; 'del espacio' is plainer.

spirit.name: espíritu
spirit.meaning: That which responds to the spirit circuit of the Eternal Son; a level of reality distinct from matter and mind, and in man the divine spirit that indwells the mind (0:6.1, 0:5.9, 0:6.8).

rejected.reason: 'Soul' is a separate term in the papers (0:5.10); 'alma' must stay for it.
Archaic, and carries the sense of a soul in purgatory.
The reader must not bring the ghost, the mood, or the distilled-liquor senses to the term.

spirit-advocate.name: Espíritu-Abogado
spirit-advocate.meaning: The member of a conciliating commission, appointed by the judge-arbiter, who presents evidence and safeguards the rights of all personalities involved (25:2.7).

rejected.reason: Closes the compound to 'an advocate of spiritual type'; the English leaves open whether 'Spirit' names the nature of the being or its domain.
Reads as 'the Spirit's lawyer', which changes the idea.

spirit-co-ordinators.name: coordinadores del espíritu
spirit-co-ordinators.meaning: The third group of superior seraphim, based on Salvington, who prepare ascenders for the transition from the highest morontia level to newborn spirit status (39:2.6).

rejected.reason: Reads as 'religious coordinators' (a parish role).
Implies they coordinate spirit beings; their work is the transition to spirit status.

spirit-fused-mortals.name: mortales fusionados con el Espíritu
spirit-fused-mortals.meaning: Ascending mortals who fuse, after death and at reawakening on the mansion worlds, with an individualization of the premind spirit of the Third Source (the local universe Mother Spirit) rather than with an Adjuster; they normally remain in their local universe (40:9.1, 40:10.2).

rejected.reason: 'Fundido' also means 'melted' and colloquially 'burnt out, broken'.
'Por' makes the Spirit the agent of the fusion instead of the partner in it.

spirit-mortals.name: mortales espíritu
spirit-mortals.meaning: Mortals of origin who have attained spirit status in the ascension (cf. 39:2.6 'newborn spirit beings').

rejected.reason: Reads as 'spiritually minded mortals' on earth, the opposite of the intended status.
Reads as 'spirited mortals'.

spirit-mother.name: Madre Espíritu
spirit-mother.meaning: The local universe Mother Spirit (Divine Minister) seen as the mother of the local creation (Paper 34).

rejected.reason: That is the fixed form of 'Mother Spirit'; the English inverts the order here, so the Spanish does too.

spirit-of-god.name: espíritu de Dios
spirit-of-god.meaning: The liaison of all spiritual ministry, the union of the spirits of the Father, the Son, the Spirit, and God the Sevenfold; in scripture also used for the Infinite Spirit or the local Creative Spirit (8:5.3, 8:5.6, 34:6.7).

rejected.reason: The capital would close the reading to one person; the English lowercase keeps the wider sense of 8:5.6. Use the capital only where the English has it (8:5.3).

spirit-of-truth.name: Espíritu de la Verdad
spirit-of-truth.meaning: The spirit of the Creator Son, also of the Father, poured out at Pentecost as the new teacher that leads believers into all truth (194:2.3, 194:2.11, 194:3.8).

rejected.reason: Without the article it reads as a quality ('a truthful spirit'); 'de la Verdad' names the one spirit.

spiritington.name: Spiritington
spiritington.meaning: The third of the seven sacred worlds of the Father around Paradise, the 'bosom of the Spirit', home of the high beings that represent the Infinite Spirit; its secrets involve reflectivity (13:1.9, 13:1.10).

rejected.reason: Rule 3: a name that exists only in this book keeps its English spelling.

spirits-of-brotherhood.name: espíritus de la fraternidad
spirits-of-brotherhood.meaning: Planetary helper seraphim who work for racial harmony and social co-operation among the races (39:5).

rejected.reason: 'Hermandad' also names a religious confraternity or a guild.

spirits-of-the-havona-circuits.name: Espíritus de los Circuitos de Havona
spirits-of-the-havona-circuits.meaning: The Seven Spirits of the Havona Circuits considered as an order (Paper 24).

rejected.reason: Turns the name Havona into an adjective.

spirits-of-trust.name: espíritus de la confianza
spirits-of-trust.meaning: Planetary helper seraphim of the Adamic regime who inculcate trust into the minds of evolving men (39:5.7).

rejected.reason: Without the article it reads as 'trustworthy spirits' (de confianza = reliable), which changes the idea.

spiritual-energy-manipulators.name: manipuladores de energía espiritual
spiritual-energy-manipulators.meaning: Celestial artisans who study the laws of spiritual energy and develop improved techniques for its intake by morontia and other beings (44:5.4).

rejected.reason: Loses the match with the other 'energy manipulators' of 44:5.
The reader must not bring the sense of deceit; it means one who handles energy.

suns.name: soles
suns.meaning: The stars of space, which also serve as way stations for energy circuits (41:3.1).

superuniverses.name: superuniversos
superuniverses.meaning: The seven evolutionary universes of time and space that circle Havona (0:0.5, 15:0.1).

supreme.name: Supremo
supreme.meaning: God the Supreme, the evolving Deity of time and space, who becomes the highest finite manifestation of the total will of God (117:0.1).

rejected.reason: Is a separate alias of the Supreme in the papers ('Supreme Being'); the term here is the bare 'Supreme'.

third-source-personalities.name: personalidades de la Tercera Fuente
third-source-personalities.meaning: Beings personal to the Infinite Spirit but not in the Father's personality circuit, such as power directors (40:9.1, Paper 30).

rejected.reason: 'Source' is 'Fuente' in 'Primera Fuente y Centro'; 'origen' is 'origin'.

thought-adjuster-of-jesus.name: Ajustador del Pensamiento de Jesús
aliases: el Ajustador Personalizado que moraba en él
thought-adjuster-of-jesus.meaning: The Adjuster who indwelt Jesus, who earlier served Machiventa Melchizedek and became a Personalized Adjuster and chief of Adjusters in Nebadon after the baptism (Paper 136).

rejected.reason: Breaks the fixed form 'Ajustadores del Pensamiento'.

thought-adjusters.name: Ajustadores del Pensamiento
thought-adjusters.meaning: Fragments of the Universal Father that indwell the mortal mind and adjust it toward the Father's will; they are the Father's love incarnate in the souls of men (107:0.2, 107:2.7, 194:2.11).

rejected.reason: Suggests control or regulation of thought; the papers describe a guiding spirit, not a regulator.
The plural suggests they adjust individual thoughts; the term names the indwelling spirit of the mind.
Reads as a musical tuner.

transportation-personalities.name: personalidades de transporte
transportation-personalities.meaning: Beings that carry other beings through space, as the seconaphim of the superuniverses and the seraphic transporters of the planets (39:5.10, 19:7.4, Paper 28).

rejected.reason: 'Transportadores' is kept for 'transporters', a separate English term (39:5.10).

trinity-absolute.name: Trinidad Absoluta
trinity-absolute.meaning: The second experiential Trinity of God the Supreme, God the Ultimate, and the Consummator of Universe Destiny, whose unification would actualize God the Absolute (0:10.1, Paper 104).

rejected.reason: Reads as 'the Trinity that belongs to the Absolute'.

trinity-teacher-sons.name: Hijos Instructores de la Trinidad
trinity-teacher-sons.meaning: Paradise Sons brought into being by the Paradise Trinity, the Daynals, superteachers who are neither magistrates nor administrators (20:7.1, 35:0.1).

rejected.reason: 'Maestro' already translates 'Master' (Master Spirits, the Master); one English word keeps one Spanish word.
Reads as a school employee.

universal-absolute.name: Absoluto Universal
universal-absolute.meaning: The Absolute that unifies and co-ordinates the dynamic infinity of Total Deity and the static infinity of the Unqualified Absolute, resolving the tension between them (0:3.21, 0:11.1, 0:11.12).

rejected.reason: 'Cosmic' is a different English word.

universal-father.name: Padre Universal
universal-father.meaning: The First Person of Deity, the First Source and Center, God as the Father of all personalities (1:0.1, 15:0.1).

rejected.reason: Not a name the papers use; it loses the term 'Universal'.

universe-power-directors.name: Directores del Poder del Universo
universe-power-directors.meaning: The living beings who direct force control and energy regulation in the master universe (29:0.1, 41:3.1).

rejected.reason: 'Potencia' fits physical energy, but 'Power' must have one form across terms (for example 'Supreme Power Directors', 'Power Centers'); 'poder' covers both senses.
'Universe' is a noun used as a modifier, not 'Universal'; the other terms use 'del Universo'.

unqualified-absolute.name: Absoluto Incondicionado
unqualified-absolute.meaning: The nonpersonal, extradivine, undeified Absolute that pervades all space and is the source of cosmic force; the static infinity set against the Deity Absolute (0:3.21, 0:6.5, 0:11.6, 42:2.3).

rejected.reason: 'Calificado' means 'skilled' or 'graded'; and 'incalificable' means 'outrageous'.
'Cualificado' means 'skilled, trained'; the English means 'not limited or conditioned'.
'Unlimited' would merge with 'infinite'.

urantia.name: Urantia
urantia.meaning: The name of our world, one of many inhabited planets of the local universe of Nebadon (0:0.5).

urantia-papers.name: Documentos de Urantia
urantia-papers.meaning: The papers of this revelation, presented by a commission from Uversa and other celestial authors (0:0.5).

rejected.reason: 'Papel' is a sheet of paper or a role; the packet sets 'paper' as 'documento'.

world-of-the-spirit.name: mundo del Espíritu
world-of-the-spirit.meaning: Transitional culture world number 6 of a local system, the rendezvous of the high personalities of the Infinite Spirit (45:1.8, 53:7.5).

rejected.reason: Reads as 'the spirit world' in general (the afterlife), not a named sphere.
